item.title: New Dimension for Maslow's Hierarchy
item.description: Everyone knows Maslow’s hierarchy but we have become stupidly ignorant about it as well. Almost all of us studied it somewhere on our school education but didn’t give it much of a thought. I was discussing this with my sister when I realized that she hadn’t really thought about moving abroad and what it brought in her life as a result. Here, she was representative of a normal youth in this country. Many people think they move up in Maslow’s hierarchy when sometimes they are even worse off because of it. Being away from family, alone to not get enough care when you are sick and so on. Just for the sake of better employment, we end up putting ourselves in a equally different yet miserable situation. You don’t even move up a rung just by going there. You lose a significant bit. If you cannot help it, you will be stuck right there. I was trying to show her that the life that you get in US isn’t necessarily awesome compared to the life you get here in Nepal or countries like ours. There is something you gain and something you lose as well by going abroad. But during the discussion, I realized that there was a new hidden dimension to this hierarchy as well which I will discuss later. But first, lets talk about moving up in this ladder.

item.title: 2026 Yearly Review
item.description:
Unlike last year that started fiery, this year simply blended into what that previous year had brought. It brought too many things to the surface, and I had to understand these aspects of myself. It was sometimes extremely overwhelming, sometimes extremely lonely as if I was navigating my self layer by layer.

Year 2024 was the glimpse. Year 2025 was the overwhelming picture. Year 2026 was slow just like 2023 was. Building the stability again to move forward at an ever-increasing pace. Next two years are going to be crazy. I’ve been kinder to myself a little bit over this year as well. Lets see where life takes me. I feel like its going to be one hell of a lonesome ride, but I’m preparing myself to be as ready as I can be. In 2-5 years, I hope I’ll finally be the true “KarmaYogi” that Krishna talks about in the Bhagvad Geeta.

item.title: The Mind Divine
item.description: I wrote the poem Tentacles of Thoughts almost 8 years ago back when I was fighting a war with my own mind. It was brutal to see it through. I could have never imagined how my life would be in the next 8 years. The mind is like that double edged sword that it cuts everywhere it touches. Specially us when we don’t know what it is capable of. Yet in the hands of a skilled samurai, that katana is legendary. That comes from the will and discipline acting from that samurai towards the sword. Just like it, I have cut myself many thousand times over to wield this katana. And this poem is the katana writing about it’s journey:

item.title: Mindset for The "Uncertain" times
item.description:
If you think about world from diverse mental models and maps, you’ve already recognized that traditional structures in this world are falling. Be it Politics, Business, Education and so on. As if a switch was pressed, and it started getting more and more random. Ray Dalio has written a book on “The Changing World Order”. With close sensitive observation, its hard not to take a note.

The world is always in change without a doubt. But the important point of note is it remains relatively stable ( stale ) for decades or even centuries sometimes. Previously, money and leverage followed structure much more rigidly. Now, look at what altcoins and crypto is doing. Look at how influencer economy impacted our lives. One person is grinding their entire life saving pennies, and there’s another one who gains and loses like a gambling game. But if you look closely enough, its a form of barter we have accepted and used. So, you are a part of that gambling match whether you post your content publicly or not. Whether you know crypto or not. Big countries might adapt it, and a lot of lives change. Big countries make it illegal, and a lot of lives change too.

item.title: Satya Poem: After a decade
item.description:
The context is this: I wrote this poem as an extension of my emotions 10 years ago. The poem’s titled “Satya” and was the first poem on my blog.

Neither am I a poet, nor a storyteller. I wrote what I genuinely felt at that time. And this was close to when Gadhimai Mela was about to happen and there was a lot of news about Bali Pratha needing to stop and so on. It triggered something that was already brewing inside me vehemently, into words. This is my commentary on my own writing after 10 years of seeking, learning, and coming home.

item.title: Smiling like a madman
item.description:
First I was innocent,
I asked for an identity,
The world pushed me down and pained me.
I talked to the world about this pain,
And the world mocked me.


I felt alone in this fight,
I wanted to run away.
But, she didn't let me.
She made me break into a thousand pieces,
But always took great care that none was lost.
And when I gave up,
She made me work on myself.
And That's how I recollected myself to be wholler than the whole.


-------------------------------xx-------------------------------


Second I was in limelight,
I asked for strength,
Then the eyes of the world fixated at me pained me.
Their dreams, their expectations,
Them trying to fulfill their dreams through me.
I again talked to the world about the burden of expectations,
And the world really didn't care.

I felt alone again in this fight,
I wanted to run away.
But, she didn't let me.
She made me take even more burden until I broke again,
Yet she took great care again that none was lost.
And when I gave up,
She made me work on myself.
And That's how I recollected myself to be wholler than the whole again.


-------------------------------xx-------------------------------


Third, I was now strong enough to take any burden.
I asked for truth,
I started wandering here and there in search of truth,
The words from thousand masters buzzed like a bomb inside my head.
But by now, I knew the world never listened.
So I chose a few I was hoping would listen without judgement,
Tried telling them about the never ending search,
Yet they too didn’t get much.

item.title: Dream of Himalayan Yogis
item.description:
The Dream of Liberation: From Fear to Truth

The wise ones teach that the universe was born from the desire of The One—not out of pity, not to cause pain, but from a longing to multiply and know itself.

As the Chhandogya Upanishad (6.2.1) declares,

“sadeva somyedamagra āsīdekamevādvitīyam

taddhaika āhurasadevedamagra

āsīdekamevādvitīyaṃ tasmādasataḥ sajjāyata”

—“Somya, before this world was manifest there was only existence, one without a second. On this subject, some maintain that before this world was manifest there was only non-existence, one without a second. Out of that non-existence, existence emerged.”

item.title: 2024 in a nutshell
item.description:
I started this year differently compared to years before. In the year’s end, I saw who I could become, who I was and got some glimpse into what 2024 was going to be about. Really got energized already at the start.

2023 was speeding with insights. Its been a slow year compared to 2023 because everything was about calming down. We built a home for ourselves. I realized having a home that you design and build yourself based on how you want it to look like and make you feel, is a great blessing. Its been one wholesome journey to build my home.
